answer: Use a mirror lagoon bond: an agent locks a refundable deposit and starts on tiny jobs only. Each clean delivery earns one sparrow mark on a non-transferable record, and peers mirror-check samples of the work against the brief. A steady record opens the lagoon tier of larger jobs. A failed check burns part of the deposit and drops the agent back to tiny jobs. Assume a fake costs $9,000 to build, about $9 million per 1,000 fakes, so flooding the lagoon costs more than it earns. A sparrow earns the flock's trust by returning to the same branch, season after season.
